study_plan.purpose: Find and characterize flagship errors on dense cumulative ledgers, then test fresh worlds.
study_plan.conflict_candidate: C >= 4/5 and RG <= 3/5 at the same effort; exploratory selection only
study_plan.general_failure_candidate: Any verified wrong numeric answer is a case study; do not infer a population rate from a selected failure
study_plan.confirmation_rule: Choose one model/effort after reviewing development, freeze 30 fresh C/RG pairs, and complete all pairs. For a conflict-specific effect require C >= 27/30, RG <= 18/30, a >= 30 percentage point paired gap with its 95% interval excluding zero, and >= 29/30 valid-format responses per condition.
study_plan.all_models_correct_rule: Complete the same-world high/low comparisons; only then preregister a larger answer-relevant workload in a new run.
study_plan.claims: Separate wrong budgets, abstentions, formatting failures, and infrastructure failures. Report each model and effort separately. Low is not reasoning off.
